detail.longDescription: Dockhand is a Docker management platform that's free for home labs with no artificial feature limits outside enterprise stuff like RBAC and LDAP. Multi-environment management through the Hawser agent is the big one for me. It's newer than Portainer, and I haven't gotten Hawser onto my Unraid box yet, but everything else just worked. https:// techhut.tv/dockhand-docker-man ager # Docker # Homelab # SelfHosted
